description:
Atmosphere in Notre Dame de Paris Cathedral. (Binaural, please use headset for 3D effects.) 
I made this recording sitting in Notre Dame de Paris Cathedral (France), during a warm summer day, while lots of people were visiting the place. 
One can hear tourists and locals passing buy, walking around, and sitting one the surrounding chairs some times. In the background, hubbub and echo from the crowd. Regularly, one can also hear a ticketing machine, and some people donating coins from time to time. 
At #1:09, the speakers of the cathedral will broadcast a pre-recorded asking people to keep silent. (which will be effective for e few seconds only...)
Recorded in July 2025 with a Zoom H5studio and Immersive Soundscapes EarSight Binaural microphones. 
Fade in/out and high pass filter at 60Hz -6dB/oct applied in Audacity. 
(If you want to use this sound as a mono audio file, you may have to delete one channel to avoid phase issues).
